tests.name: Single server's tool count vs the model's cap
tests.what: Checks whether THIS ONE server's tool count alone would exceed the model's per-request cap. This is a single-server upper-bound check; the binding limit across all connected servers is ENV_AGGREGATE_TOOL_COUNT.

tests.name: Tools physically fit the context window
tests.what: For models with NO vendor hard cap (Anthropic, all open-weight), computes the structural ceiling = how many tools of this server's average definition size fit in the window with output headroom, and checks the server stays under it. Single-server view; the window is shared, so the binding fit-check across all servers is ENV_AGGREGATE_FOOTPRINT.
tests.rec: Reduce per-tool definition size (shorter descriptions, leaner schemas) or raise the serving context (self-host: --max-model-len). The derived ceiling scales with the window, so a larger-window model lifts this limit.

anthropic.cons: A large window absorbs many tools; the fit-ceiling is high, so this is mostly a per-call cost concern.
